stage: C: appearance review; stop before A

measurement.method: Manual top/right/bottom/left endpoints of worn visible tile boundaries; straight chords, dy/dx for each edge; all 10 tiles and all 40 edges equally weighted. Approximate endpoint uncertainty ±2 logical px. No stair measurements.

shape.method: alpha>=200 column extrema; least-squares dy/dx over central20–80% of each half-edge; opposite pairs compared relative to larger absolute slope

criteria.method: longest continuous x-interval with a warm opaque near-black pixel2–5px above lower alpha edge; same fraction as straight chord length
